note: Water heater serial-number date conventions, in our own words. Source: City of Palo Alto Utilities, 'Check Your Water Heater's Age', read 2026-10-30 (kb/SOURCES.md). A date code is a manufacturer convention, not a guarantee: results are 'estimated' and the technician confirms. A manufacture date printed on the plate always wins.
source: City of Palo Alto Utilities, Check Your Water Heater's Age (read 2026-10-30)

rheem_mmyy.label: Rheem/Ruud: first four digits are month then year (MMYY)

aosmith_yyww.label: A.O. Smith (2008 on): first four digits are year then week (YYWW)

aosmith_pre2008.label: A.O. Smith (before 2008): second character is a month letter (A = January, I skipped), next two digits the year

bw_letters.label: Bradford White: first letter is the year, second the month; letters repeat every 20 years (I, O, Q, R, U, V not used)
